description: Original trainers. 'ai' selects the decision tier. 'boss' trainers get only limited adaptive scaling and keep a fixed identity.

trainers.dialogue_intro: Nova: Let's see whose partner is stronger!
trainers.dialogue_defeat: Nova: Not bad... I'll train harder!
trainers.dialogue_victory: Nova: Better luck next time!

trainers.dialogue_intro: Perrin: The wilds sharpen everyone. Show me your edge.
trainers.dialogue_defeat: Perrin: Sharp indeed.
trainers.dialogue_victory: Perrin: The wilds win today.

trainers.dialogue_intro: Sable: The Verdant Trial rewards the adaptable. Begin.
trainers.dialogue_defeat: Sable: You bent with the wind and did not break. The badge is yours.
trainers.dialogue_victory: Sable: Come again when your bond is deeper.

trainers.dialogue_intro: Wrenn: Aquilon respects a thinking trainer. Prove you are one.
trainers.dialogue_defeat: Wrenn: A worthy mind. Champion Isolde awaits in the Summit Hall, above the ridge.
trainers.dialogue_victory: Wren: Think harder next time.

trainers.dialogue_intro: Isolde: Two regions carried you here. Show me what they taught you.
trainers.dialogue_defeat: Isolde: The north bows to you, Champion. Wear the Aquilon Crest with pride.
trainers.dialogue_victory: Isolde: The summit is patient. Return when you are ready.

trainers.dialogue_intro: Scout: The volcanic slopes test every traveler. Show me your mettle.
trainers.dialogue_defeat: Scout: The hall road is yours.
trainers.dialogue_victory: Scout: The wilds win today.

trainers.dialogue_victory: Champion of Cindral: Come back when the badges feel heavier.
